create_nllb_moe_config: create an NllbMoeConfig instance with default settings for the facebook/nllb-moe-54b model
create_nllb_moe_config_custom: create an NllbMoeConfig with custom num_experts, expert_capacity, and router_dtype parameters
create_nllb_moe_model: create an NllbMoeModel from an NllbMoeConfig for encoder-decoder multilingual translation
configure_moe_routing: configure MoE routing with router_bias, router_z_loss_coef, and router_aux_loss_coef settings
configure_sparse_layers: configure encoder and decoder sparse layer steps for MoE expert distribution
